issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: Loan Simple leads were enrolling in multiple workflow branches simultaneously, causing HAs and TCs to receive duplicate tasks across post-referral, pre-referral, and sale pending workflows. The root cause was a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. The issue was resolved after working with HubSpot support.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close or delete the duplicate tasks as needed.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that previously fell through
issues.desc: The Offer Accepted TC assignment workflow did not allow re-enrollment, so deals that had previously been marked Offer Accepted, reverted to an earlier stage, and then returned to Offer Accepted again would not trigger TC tasks a second time. This affected deals like Brandee Smith's where a contract fell through on 3/16 and re-entered Offer Accepted on 4/7. The workflow was updated to allow re-enrollment.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any affected deals into the TC assignment workflow to ensure tasks are created for the TC.

issues.title: MRC and TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows not triggering correctly
issues.desc: MRC and other TC Sale Pending and Offer Accepted workflows failed to enroll or trigger tasks for affected leads during a window spanning late February through early April 2026. HAs and TCs were not receiving tasks for deals updated to Offer Accepted during this period. The fix was confirmed complete on April 1, 2026 after engagement with HubSpot support, with a noted impact window of February 26 through April 1.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any MRC or TC deals updated to Offer Accepted or Sale Pending between February 26 and April 1 into the appropriate workflow to generate missing tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not stopping when deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: The post-referral workflow continued to generate check-in tasks even after a deal was marked as Closed Lost or Transferred, causing HAs to receive irrelevant tasks for inactive deals. The issue was identified on March 9, 2026 and a tweak was made to the workflow filters to suppress tasks for those deal stages. Transferred deals were also affected.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss or delete any post-referral check-in tasks that were generated after a deal was marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks not triggered for referral accepted on March 18
issues.desc: A post-referral workflow failed to generate any tasks after a referral was made and accepted on March 18, 2026. The root cause was an error in how data was being pulled, preventing the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was sent to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll affected leads into the post-referral workflow to generate the missing tasks.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent at Offer Accepted stage without credit amount populated
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was being sent when a deal entered the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated, resulting in an incomplete message. The SMS should only trigger at the Sale Pending stage once the credit amount is known. The issue was confirmed to be a dash-triggered communication and was referred to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually send the correct buyer credit SMS with the appropriate credit amount to any buyers who received the incomplete message during the impact window.

issues.title: Automated emails showing previous loan officer after LO change on a deal
issues.desc: When a loan officer was changed on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the previous LO rather than the updated one. In the reported example, emails were still showing Paul instead of the correct LO, Julie Yocum. The issue was resolved by Luis.
issues.workaround: Manually resend any automated emails that went out with the incorrect LO information to ensure agents received the correct contact details.
